role: Observe current GEL New/Edit form structure and authentic browser serialization while preventing every GEL tutorial mutation from reaching the server.

accepted_claims.NEW-1: New form and create POST omit datetime; GEL assigns identity server-side.
accepted_claims.TEACHER-1: New form-provided tid represents the authenticated teacher in the captured create flow.
accepted_claims.TEACHER-2: Ordinary revision preserves the historical tutorial tid even under a different authenticated teacher.
accepted_claims.TEACHER-3: Deliberate teacher reassignment server acceptance/semantics are not established.
accepted_claims.UPDATE-1: Revision form/POST preserve the existing datetime.

authority.established_project_fact: The latest tutorial is always the prepopulation source for a New tutorial; PW1 audits field-by-field copy/reset/derive behaviour and does not re-infer source provenance.
authority.current_live_evidence_rule: PW1 confirms current client/form behaviour and classifies drift. It does not silently supersede historical authority.

allowed_mutation.purpose: GEL login handshake submitted by the interactive /corelogin/ page only

authentication.all_other_mutations: DEPRECATED: see origin_policy; unexpected GEL mutations abort_and_fail_closed, third-party mutations abort_nonfatal

interactive_login_page.purpose: operator enters credentials directly into GEL browser UI; harness never reads credential control values

blocked_mutation_diagnostic.purpose: Reveal the route shape required by the interactive login flow without exposing credentials/session material or widening mutation authority.

two_stage_manual_login.historical_basis: GEL login requires the corelogin handshake followed by Learn2 /user/login session establishment.
two_stage_manual_login.evidence_phase_transition: Only after a GET-only Learn2 session verification reports authenticated.

evidence.all_other_mutations: DEPRECATED: see origin_policy; unexpected GEL mutations abort_and_fail_closed, third-party mutations abort_nonfatal

third_party_origins.reason: Third-party analytics/telemetry cannot write GEL tutorial state and is not evidence of GEL contract drift.

progress_diagnostic.purpose: Identify the evidence stage of a fail-closed exception without exposing browser/network/form data.

credential_privacy.credential_entry: operator types directly into GEL browser page

persisted_evidence_privacy_metadata.policy: negative capture assertions use privacy-safe metadata keys that do not resemble forbidden raw-data field names
persisted_evidence_privacy_metadata.guard_rule: assert_privacy_safe_evidence remains strict; schema metadata is renamed rather than allowlisting forbidden key fragments

teacher_semantics.new_default: historically proven to use authenticated-teacher form tid
teacher_semantics.revision_default: historically proven to preserve historical tutorial tid
teacher_semantics.client_change_probe: Where an enabled select with at least two teacher options exists, choose an alternate only in the browser and observe the authentic outgoing POST before aborting it.
teacher_semantics.writer_enablement_consequence: PW1 evidence alone must not enable production teacher reassignment.
teacher_semantics.live_revision_selector: observed editable select with 55 positive options; browser selection changed successfully
teacher_semantics.writer_product_rule: Revision always preserves the historical teacher; teacher reassignment is unsupported and not an N2 gate.

prepopulation.pw1_question: For each New target type, compare only the canonical same-semantic field identity and classify copy/reset/derive behaviour; never search unrelated fields for equal values.
prepopulation.comparison_scope: in-memory canonical semantic field identity only; field IDs/roles are authoritative

identity_projection.subject: route_identity represented by subject_ref only; student_uid semantic key/value is not persisted
identity_projection.teacher: relationship-only rule under identity_rules.teacher; teacher_id semantic key/value is not persisted

prepopulation.forbidden_inference: Cross-field provenance from equal values is forbidden; earlier copied_from_source_field/matches_multiple_source_fields results are superseded.

zero_write_verification.create_probe: Fresh summary GET must have the same student-free tutorial locator count+digest as baseline.
zero_write_verification.revision_probe: Fresh historical edit GET must have the same normalized semantic-state digest as baseline.
zero_write_verification.final_summary: Tutorial locator digest must still match baseline.
zero_write_verification.request_counter_rule: Every expected tutorial mutation is aborted; no tutorial POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE is forwarded during EVIDENCE or VERIFY.

failure_semantics.unexpected_mutation: Unexpected GEL-origin mutation: abort request and fail run.
failure_semantics.unexpected_submission_encoding: abort request and classify contract drift/unparseable; never fall back to raw persistence
failure_semantics.unknown_teacher_selector_shape: record topology; do not manufacture a teacher mutation
failure_semantics.authentication_failure: Remain in AUTHENTICATION until a GET-only /administration/students verification succeeds. If stage 1 does not establish Learn2 but the canonical login POST was observed, open /user/login for a second manual browser-only credential submission. Fail closed after stage 2 if the verification remains unauthenticated. Diagnostics contain only login POST count, authenticated boolean, origin/redacted path and password-control presence.
failure_semantics.interactive_login_page_unavailable: fail closed; do not navigate to the POST handshake endpoint as a substitute interactive page
failure_semantics.third_party_mutation: Abort without body/header inspection; count as blocked third-party traffic; do not fail or classify as GEL contract drift.
failure_semantics.privacy_projection_violation: fail_closed before evidence write; no raw value is printed or persisted

live_pass_requires: credential values captured by harness = NO
any authentication-phase blocked mutation diagnostic contains only phase/method/origin/redacted_path and is not persisted

AUTHENTICATION -> EVIDENCE occurs only after GET-only Learn2 session verification succeeds; if /corelogin/ alone is insufficient, the manual /user/login stage is completed in the same ephemeral browser context without credential inspection
authentic New submission serialization is intercepted and aborted for required probes
revision datetime is preserved in intercepted serialization
existing tutorial semantic digest remains unchanged
forwarded GEL tutorial mutations during evidence = 0
unexpected GEL mutation attempts = 0; blocked third-party telemetry may be nonzero and is non-fatal
acceptance.privacy_projection: The complete initial evidence document and complete prepopulation projection must pass assert_privacy_safe_evidence before any live evidence file write.

residual_status.reason: Normal Tutorial Writer revisions preserve the existing historical teacher and never need to change teacher attribution.
